method: Primary topic and secondary tags reviewed against full collected abstracts; result summaries are author-reported, not independently reproduced. Mechanism alignment is analyst synthesis, not proof of common production integration.

dcn_ai.label: DCN & AI infrastructure
dcn_ai.definition: Datacenter fabrics, AI communication and observability, distributed data processing, and VPC path reliability.

cloud_gateway.label: Cloud gateways & offload
cloud_gateway.definition: Cloud edge routing, programmable gateways, flow/session tables and DPU acceleration.

rtc_qoe.label: Interactive media & QoE
rtc_qoe.definition: Cloud gaming and interactive streaming across encoding, transport and last-mile access; not a general CDN/caching category.

wan.label: WAN & optical systems
wan.definition: Optical telemetry/capacity, WAN traffic engineering and production-network emulation.

operations.label: Measurement & operations
operations.definition: Measurement discovery, composable switch emulation and heterogeneous gateway tracing.

security.label: Security & privacy
security.definition: DDoS detection and metadata-private messaging, with distinct threat models.

cloud_resource.label: Cloud resource optimization
cloud_resource.definition: Hestia CPU oversubscription; retained as the explicitly marked networking-boundary paper.

tn-c91f67aec75ff7e3.mechanism: Focused crawler and positive-unlabeled classifier expand measurement vantage points.
tn-c91f67aec75ff7e3.result: The tool retrieves 910 obscure automatable Looking Glass vantage points.
tn-c91f67aec75ff7e3.evaluation: Crawler experiments and an AS-topology case study; a research measurement asset, not a Tencent product KPI.
tn-c91f67aec75ff7e3.implication: Broader external visibility can improve measurement coverage; production adoption by Tencent is not established.

tn-5ee87295c2b32206.mechanism: Separate cloud-router access, forwarding, routing and SDN-control modules so they scale independently.
tn-5ee87295c2b32206.result: Authors report years of operational experience supporting growth in cloud access traffic.
tn-5ee87295c2b32206.evaluation: Production architecture and operational account; the abstract does not supply a single comparable improvement ratio.
tn-5ee87295c2b32206.implication: The plausible advantage is feature velocity and independent scaling instead of proprietary-router dependence.

tn-b5ad07b326ead5ae.mechanism: Vendor-agnostic streaming optical telemetry with controller-side data management.
tn-b5ad07b326ead5ae.result: One-second telemetry detects twice as many optical events; six months of backbone use are reported.
tn-b5ad07b326ead5ae.evaluation: Comparison to existing telemetry systems, plus production observations; event detection is not equivalent to outage reduction.
tn-b5ad07b326ead5ae.implication: Fine-grained operational data is a reusable capability for later reliability work.

tn-4b11634a6e5ae8d9.mechanism: Burst-aware measurement and replacement policies manage hybrid hardware/software flow tables.
tn-4b11634a6e5ae8d9.result: Experiments report up to about 50% less software CPU use and about 97.6% lower tail forwarding latency than the evaluated alternatives.
tn-4b11634a6e5ae8d9.evaluation: ConnectX-5/P4-switch prototypes and real traffic traces; this is not an all-fleet production saving.
tn-4b11634a6e5ae8d9.implication: Better use of scarce offload-table capacity can reduce fallback CPU cost.

tn-9d8ab9ccefaaabf8.mechanism: Secure enclaves and oblivious shuffling hide communication metadata under an explicit hardware trust assumption.
tn-9d8ab9ccefaaabf8.result: A 32-machine evaluation reports 7.76-second p99 latency for roughly one million clients.
tn-9d8ab9ccefaaabf8.evaluation: Research-system evaluation; secure-enclave trust and messaging latency are essential qualifiers. The collected HTML renders the client exponent imperfectly; the report does not use it as a headline metric.
tn-9d8ab9ccefaaabf8.implication: A distinct privacy research connection, not evidence of a deployed consumer-messaging feature.

tn-d230948cc184da0b.mechanism: Adapt frame rate jointly to network fluctuation and client decoder capacity.
tn-d230948cc184da0b.result: Reported reductions reach 7.4× for tail queuing delay and average stuttering reduction of 34%; production use exceeds one year.
tn-d230948cc184da0b.evaluation: Trace-driven simulations and in-the-wild deployment; benefits concern specified end-to-end delay and decoder queues.
tn-d230948cc184da0b.implication: QoE improves by controlling the producer and decoder pipeline, not only the network.

tn-7f940cb9306f8c5c.mechanism: Co-design spacing-variable optical hardware, centralized vendor-agnostic control and capacity planning.
tn-7f940cb9306f8c5c.result: The paper reports at least 57% fewer transponders and 36% less spectrum usage in its evaluated settings.
tn-7f940cb9306f8c5c.evaluation: Production experience and capacity-planning comparisons; hardware savings are not directly Tencent's total WAN expenditure reduction.
tn-7f940cb9306f8c5c.implication: Optical flexibility creates a plausible capex and resilience lever; absolute fleet-wide savings are unknown.

tn-0abe63a6f29c790f.mechanism: Kernel-modification-free primary/backup BGP replication in lightweight virtualized components.
tn-0abe63a6f29c790f.result: Two-year operation on 400 servers and over 31,000 BGP peerings; reported development/deployment/maintenance cost factors are 20×/5×/10× versus the paper's router approach.
tn-0abe63a6f29c790f.evaluation: Operational cost estimates and testbed comparisons; cost factors have different denominators and must not be multiplied.
tn-0abe63a6f29c790f.implication: Programmable reliability may lower operational friction while retaining non-stop routing.

tn-4ee11d0388e5e33b.mechanism: Choose retransmission timing and Wi-Fi/cellular paths using per-session models and optimization.
tn-4ee11d0388e5e33b.result: Reported improvements reach 66.0% lower tail latency, 99.5% lower frame stall rate and 88.1% less cellular data use than compared multipath schemes.
tn-4ee11d0388e5e33b.evaluation: Trace-driven emulation and Tencent START deployment; these are conditional maxima against selected baselines.
tn-4ee11d0388e5e33b.implication: Tail-latency control must also respect the user's cellular-data budget.

tn-e948a761d296771f.mechanism: Differentiate redundancy for initial transmissions and retransmissions across multiple rounds.
tn-e948a761d296771f.result: Production experiments report average reductions of 40% in bandwidth cost and 32% in deadline misses.
tn-e948a761d296771f.evaluation: In-the-wild comparisons to the paper's state-of-the-art baselines; packet/frame deadline definitions matter.
tn-e948a761d296771f.implication: QoE and network cost can improve together when retransmission semantics are modeled.

tn-cf46a4678f585b3d.mechanism: Probe bandwidth utilization using paced video frames and control bitrate to avoid self-induced queues.
tn-cf46a4678f585b3d.result: The paper reports 3.1×/4.9× reductions in average/tail frame delay, a 10.3× stall-rate reduction and 12.1% higher frame bitrate.
tn-cf46a4678f585b3d.evaluation: Real-network evaluation and deployment serving millions of players; the ratios refer to different QoE measures.
tn-cf46a4678f585b3d.implication: Application pacing gives the congestion controller information generic bulk-transfer schemes lack.

tn-d91322b000762057.mechanism: Bottom-up asynchronous TE queries, eBPF segment routing and optimization contraction reach virtual-instance granularity.
tn-d91322b000762057.result: The paper reports 20× more endpoints at similar algorithm runtime and up to 51% lower real-time packet latency in production analysis.
tn-d91322b000762057.evaluation: Flow-level simulations and Tencent rollout since December 2022; algorithm scale and application latency are separate comparisons.
tn-d91322b000762057.implication: Fine-grained virtual-cloud control extends WAN infrastructure into tenant-level policy.

tn-ed6fafae3cd8bdc0.mechanism: Block-level flowlets, non-blocking middleware and reliable fallback improve RDMA shuffle.
tn-ed6fafae3cd8bdc0.result: Large-cluster results report 23.9% lower job completion time and 2.03× job completion rate than existing RDMA solutions.
tn-ed6fafae3cd8bdc0.evaluation: Apache Spark integration, small testbed and hundreds-of-servers production cluster; this is data-processing communication, not automatically LLM research.
tn-ed6fafae3cd8bdc0.implication: Infrastructure value appears as useful completed work, not just link bandwidth.

tn-fcb9ef7a1565882f.mechanism: Use abnormal communication operators and cross-iteration dependency graphs to localize silent training slowdowns.
tn-fcb9ef7a1565882f.result: Trace-driven simulation reaches 97.21% localization accuracy; a production-level prototype localizes irregularity within 30.3 seconds.
tn-fcb9ef7a1565882f.evaluation: The 97.21% accuracy is simulation, while the timing is a prototype measurement; neither alone proves fleet-wide realized training savings.
tn-fcb9ef7a1565882f.implication: Silent stragglers are an economic target even when GPUs do not fail outright.

tn-ab42eca19c84beba.mechanism: A compiler/runtime exposes constrained ECMP-group control for deterministic per-flow path actions.
tn-ab42eca19c84beba.result: The paper evaluates at scale and reports one use case deployed in a live datacenter.
tn-ab42eca19c84beba.evaluation: Simulation plus one production use case; precise control is not evidence that ECMP randomness is eliminated globally.
tn-ab42eca19c84beba.implication: Control-plane abstractions can extract more value from existing switching features.

tn-ef4ac043eef9c789.mechanism: Co-design same-rail interconnection, power/cooling, hierarchical monitoring and operator-level forecasting.
tn-ef4ac043eef9c789.result: An 18-month rollout supporting LLM training and inference for multiple customers is reported.
tn-ef4ac043eef9c789.evaluation: Production experience spans physical infrastructure and software; potential scale mentioned elsewhere in the paper is not its demonstrated deployed GPU count.
tn-ef4ac043eef9c789.implication: The competitive mechanism is stack coordination and operability rather than one isolated transport algorithm.

tn-0b6e93289d7b3005.mechanism: Hardware-centric session management replaces one-way software flow programming with bidirectional protocols.
tn-0b6e93289d7b3005.result: Testbed reductions of 80% software storage and 77% CPU use; production management of up to 16 million sessions is reported.
tn-0b6e93289d7b3005.evaluation: Separate testbed resource comparisons and large-scale production observations; not a whole-server cost ratio.
tn-0b6e93289d7b3005.implication: Management-plane efficiency is increasingly important as hardware offload tables grow.

tn-65a6af3e4e7ae273.mechanism: Translate ephemeral optical degradation into dynamic failure probabilities, pre-created tunnels and traffic allocation.
tn-65a6af3e4e7ae273.result: Large-scale simulation supports up to twice the demand at the same availability level as the evaluated schemes.
tn-65a6af3e4e7ae273.evaluation: Production-level WAN testbed for runtime feasibility plus simulation for demand/availability benefit; a production-wide 2× traffic gain is not established.
tn-65a6af3e4e7ae273.implication: An optical-telemetry-to-control loop is a plausible knowledge advantage; direct code lineage from OpTel is not proven.

tn-2e858fd1909dcbf3.mechanism: Adaptor-based interface contracts compose data-plane, control-plane and peripheral switch emulators.
tn-2e858fd1909dcbf3.result: Reported 2.2× forwarding-emulation performance; operators used the system for 97.5% of 203 issues in a recent year.
tn-2e858fd1909dcbf3.evaluation: Emulator performance and operator-use coverage; the percentage is not an outage-reduction measurement.
tn-2e858fd1909dcbf3.implication: Reproducible failure diagnosis can shorten iteration cycles across heterogeneous hardware.

tn-bb96fcc8221d7661.mechanism: Distributed adaptive Wi-Fi contention windows target packet-delivery droughts at the access point.
tn-bb96fcc8221d7661.result: Under heavy contention, tail packet latency falls by over 5×; cloud-gaming stall rate falls by over 90% in the evaluated settings.
tn-bb96fcc8221d7661.evaluation: NS3 simulation and commercial AP experiments; distinguish controlled Wi-Fi results from an Internet-wide production rollout.
tn-bb96fcc8221d7661.implication: A transport-only solution cannot remove a MAC-layer bottleneck; practical rollout requires AP access.

tn-527952756cb68624.mechanism: Programmable-switch peering offloads inbound/outbound traffic, redirects suspicious traffic and accelerates route convergence.
tn-527952756cb68624.result: The paper reports 78% lower average hardware cost than its existing-system comparison and seconds-scale route convergence.
tn-527952756cb68624.evaluation: Gradual production rollout and evaluated failure scenarios; hardware cost is not total ownership cost.
tn-527952756cb68624.implication: Commodity programmability aligns peering cost, DDoS handling and routing flexibility.

tn-2e6354ea2ff42940.mechanism: Combine dynamic load balancing across detection servers with programmable-switch traffic compression.
tn-2e6354ea2ff42940.result: The authors report scaling DDoS detection beyond 100 Tbps in real deployments.
tn-2e6354ea2ff42940.evaluation: Distributed detection scale and production deployment; volume capacity does not by itself establish detection precision or business loss avoided.
tn-2e6354ea2ff42940.implication: A security service can exploit the same programmable-network systems expertise as gateways.

tn-ac1cf0954b2c5e03.mechanism: Diagnose loss sources and combine loss avoidance, RACK-TLP detection and opportunistic FEC recovery.
tn-ac1cf0954b2c5e03.result: A one-year Tencent START rollout reports 0.049% packet loss and 99.87% of frames delivered within 100 ms.
tn-ac1cf0954b2c5e03.evaluation: Production observations; the reported 59.8% packet-loss reduction uses the paper's existing-solution baseline, not a controlled revenue experiment.
tn-ac1cf0954b2c5e03.implication: The all-Tencent paper shows that internal operational diagnosis complements the academic-heavy portfolio.

tn-a36a4f74ab914d33.mechanism: Host software monitors feasible physical paths and moves flows to healthy alternatives without special hardware.
tn-a36a4f74ab914d33.result: Over two years in Tencent Cloud; reported outage-time reductions range from 78.71% to 99.97% with sub-second failed-path bypass.
tn-a36a4f74ab914d33.evaluation: Production failure cases; the broad percentage range depends on scenario and is not a single availability SLA.
tn-a36a4f74ab914d33.implication: Software path resilience may extract reliability from an existing fabric without a hardware refresh.

tn-1d6930256b9a1c41.mechanism: Replay historical controller, forwarding and traffic state in a scalable production-aligned WAN twin.
tn-1d6930256b9a1c41.result: The abstract reports over two years of TWAN use for troubleshooting, tuning, testing and capacity assessment.
tn-1d6930256b9a1c41.evaluation: Production operational account; no direct causal incident-reduction estimate is supplied in the abstract.
tn-1d6930256b9a1c41.implication: An executable copy of the network can turn operational knowledge into repeatable tests.

tn-4ab76b7bd3b61a53.mechanism: Buffer fusion and TMA offload reduce MoE all-to-all copies and GPU SM consumption.
tn-4ab76b7bd3b61a53.result: On 16/32 GPUs, up to 119.7% higher algorithm bandwidth, 66.7% lower SM occupancy and 21.2% higher serving capacity versus DeepEP are reported.
tn-4ab76b7bd3b61a53.evaluation: Small-cluster comparison with a specified library; no fleet-scale production deployment is established by the abstract.
tn-4ab76b7bd3b61a53.implication: Freeing compute and memory-movement resources can matter as much as faster wire communication.

tn-22dcd0345e71e428.mechanism: Normalize functions across heterogeneous gateway hardware into tracing cubes and decode them for standard tracing tools.
tn-22dcd0345e71e428.result: The abstract reports under 1% memory/latency overhead and localization reduced from hours or days to minutes.
tn-22dcd0345e71e428.evaluation: Gateway deployment and author-reported diagnostic experience; the before/after times are not a uniform benchmark across incidents.
tn-22dcd0345e71e428.implication: Observability follows offload complexity into individual functions, not just network devices.

tn-b909b59461b0fe67.mechanism: Separate bandwidth-provisioning execution modules from a shared control-centric orchestration module.
tn-b909b59461b0fe67.result: The abstract reports two years in production serving over 10,000 GPUs.
tn-b909b59461b0fe67.evaluation: Official abstract and publisher metadata; final PDF is unavailable locally, so detailed cost ratios and institutional task ownership are not asserted.
tn-b909b59461b0fe67.implication: Independent control/data scaling targets the mismatch between elephant-flow bandwidth and relatively flat control demand.

tn-436ac2802fe4d482.mechanism: Restructure session layouts, pipelines and memory scheduling to use commodity DDR instead of costly advanced memory.
tn-436ac2802fe4d482.result: The abstract reports 16-million-entry tables, 80% lower memory cost and 50 Mpps processing, with deployment over three years.
tn-436ac2802fe4d482.evaluation: Official abstract and publisher deposit; a 33% testbed packet-rate improvement is separate from memory-cost savings. Final PDF access and three program-affiliation conflicts remain caveats.
tn-436ac2802fe4d482.implication: Memory organization, not simply a faster NIC, can be an offload cost lever.

tn-36a17aefb29551e5.mechanism: One DPU virtualizes multiple RNICs; offloaded per-packet balancing and credit control serve multi-tenant bare-metal AI.
tn-36a17aefb29551e5.result: The abstract reports more than two years of production use covering 8,000 GPUs.
tn-36a17aefb29551e5.evaluation: Official abstract and publisher deposit; final PDF is not locally retrievable and this scale cannot be added to DistDPU's GPU count without checking overlap.
tn-36a17aefb29551e5.implication: Tenant isolation and communication performance become a joint architecture problem.

tn-ff5fdbe08d8cd29d.mechanism: Aggregate temporally complementary workloads to reduce volatility before oversubscription.
tn-ff5fdbe08d8cd29d.result: Using CPU as the representative resource, experiments report 43.3% lower MCV and 66.74% higher oversubscription profit.
tn-ff5fdbe08d8cd29d.evaluation: Experimental objective under evaluated workloads, not observed Tencent company profit; networking-boundary candidate.
tn-ff5fdbe08d8cd29d.implication: A useful adjacent cloud-efficiency signal, but not evidence of a network-mechanism contribution.

tn-7f60f5fc47fb3fcb.mechanism: Move new-flow setup to a DPU cloud-network coprocessor while retaining CPU collaboration and software flexibility.
tn-7f60f5fc47fb3fcb.result: The abstract reports over 776K new-flow CPS at 11.7 microseconds, with 4.8× CPS and 69.2% less latency versus Fornax.
tn-7f60f5fc47fb3fcb.evaluation: Specified host-server comparison, not total fleet throughput; CPS is connections per second, not packets per second. Final PDF includes all 18 authors.
tn-7f60f5fc47fb3fcb.implication: The next bottleneck shifts from table capacity to flexible slow-path connection setup.
